name: Mechy Pilotów
style: 1990s mecha anime style, clean panel lines, cel shading, heroic angles, robots as friendly protectors and builders, warm and hopeful
cast: Recurring original designs: the ROBOT is a chunky original giant robot in teal, cream and graphite with rounded shoulder armour, a visor face with two round friendly eye lights and one small round antenna on top. The PILOT (about 14) is a girl with a short black bob and a cream flight suit with teal stripes. No V-shaped forehead crests, no white-blue-red-yellow colour scheme, no purple-and-green robots, no guns, no blades, no missiles.
